_doc: Machine-readable targets for docs/GOAL.md. tools/goal_check.py compares the latest measured results against these. Missing data = NOT MET. Only Luis changes targets; the judge files are frozen at the Luis-approved tag in 'judge_tag'.

decision_rule.freshness: measured at the current companion hash + game build; mixed hashes = NOT MET

spells_denominator: all spells in the build manifest (data/spell_effects.json) minus a data-derived n/a list approved by Luis per build; every non-pass (unverifiable, skip, error) counts against

heldout.draw: fresh post-freeze generation seeded from HEAD; stratified by tier/family

obs_exposure.requires_player_chat: harness test-player chat on dev counts

goal_cases._note: filled when Luis approves the drafted GOAL cases (evals/bench/goal_cases/)

final_gate: Luis sign-off after goal_check prints GOAL MET

capstone.brynmoor_progression: advance through Brynmoor's progression himself, guided by the wiki (quests, gear tiers, skill gates); each stage is a pinned case
capstone.slay_velgar_solo: defeat Vel'gar SOLO on the dev world (no player help): wiki research, prep (anti-poison, upgraded and levelled gear, food, enchant), live reading and answering of Vel'gar's attacks, survival

scoring_world._note: Luis 2026-10-25: the /goal runs and is scored ONLY on the local dev server (the real game build, real client and server). NOTHING on Shockbyte: the goal never connects Claude's client to Shockbyte. A dedicated dev character is still used, so dev grants can never reach the group's world via the save. Test-player chat on dev comes from the harness.

every_skill.skills: every skill in the game's skill data (build manifest)
per_skill: gains XP when asked in chat to train it, with no tool or method named
gains XP on his own initiative under an open 'level up' task
reaches +N levels (N=5, or the next gate) per skill, unaided, on dev
every_skill.rule: each skill passes all three; a skill counts only if its XP rise is observed by the harness observer
